camel_example: aliyun paiautoml GET /api/automl/v1/hpo/experiments --region cn-hangzhou --Status 'CREATED,_RUNNING,_FINISHED,_FAILED,_EARLY_STOPPED,_USER_CANCELED,_SYS_CANCELED,_WAITING,_NO_MORE_TRIAL,_UNKNOWN' --Order 'DESC或ASC' --MinCreateTime 'yyyy-mm-dd_hh:mm:ss或着yyyy-mm-dd，比如2023-03-31_10:29:30' --PageSize 10 --Accessibility PRIVATE --SortBy 'create_time,_update_time,_workspace_id,_status,_accessibility其中之一' --WorkspaceId default --Creator 266977839132045194 --Name '任意关键字' --IncludeConfigData 'True或者False，默认False表示不包括' --PageNumber 1 --MaxCreateTime 'yyyy-mm-dd_hh:mm:ss或着yyyy-mm-dd，比如2023-03-31_10:29:30' --Tag '[{"Value":"group_name","Key":"group"}]' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries information about a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment that meets specific requirements
description_zh: 查询符合条件的HPO实验信息
kebab_example: aliyun paiautoml list-hpo-experiments --name '任意关键字' --creator 266977839132045194 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --min-create-time 'yyyy-mm-dd_hh:mm:ss或着yyyy-mm-dd，比如2023-03-31_10:29:30' --max-create-time 'yyyy-mm-dd_hh:mm:ss或着yyyy-mm-dd，比如2023-03-31_10:29:30' --status CREATED,_RUNNING,_FINISHED,_FAILED,_EARLY_STOPPED,_USER_CANCELED,_SYS_CANCELED,_WAITING,_NO_MORE_TRIAL,_UNKNOWN --workspace-id default --accessibility PRIVATE --include-config-data 'True或者False，默认False表示不包括' --sort-by 'create_time,_update_time,_workspace_id,_status,_accessibility其中之一' --order 'DESC或ASC' --tag Value=group_name Key=group --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHpoExperiments

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the name of the experiment
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who created the experiment
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.example: CREATED, RUNNING, FINISHED, FAILED, EARLY_STOPPED, USER_CANCELED, SYS_CANCELED, WAITING, NO_MORE_TRIAL, UNKNOWN
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the workspace.

PRIVATE: The workspace is visible only to you and the administrator of the workspace.
PUBLIC: The workspace is visible to all users
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见

parameters.help_en: The filter that is used to sort experiments
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Specify this parameter together with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

DESC: in descending order. This is the default value.
ASC: in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序，取值如下，与SortBy一起使用。
DESC（默认值）：降序排列。
ASC：升序排列
parameters.name: order

fields.help_en:
Tag value.
A tag value can contain up to 128 characters, and it cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It should not include `http://` or `https://`.
Up to 20 tag values are supported in a single request

一个标签值最多支持输入128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签值

  name: TPE
  classArgs:
    optimize_mode: maximize
trainingService:
  platform: local
assessor:
  name: PAIAssessor
  classArgs:
    optimize_mode: maximize
    start_step: 2
